column1: 台の生成サーバー、家の中に

column2: Jobs line up in the queue and fill the GPU every ten minutes as it frees. 200 photos overnight, chosen in the morning. The machine waits, not you.

column1: 分ごとに空きを埋める

column2: The entrance to generation is a keyed HTTP endpoint. Your own tools and other apps can call the same studio. The one machine at home becomes your generation server.

column1: 枚数にも、尺にも、やり直しにも、課金の上限はない。作風も題材も、棚と会話で決める。頭脳はローカル / Claude / ChatGPT を、相談の中身で切り替える。
column2: No billing caps on count, length or retries. Looks and subjects are decided from the shelf and in conversation. The brain switches between local, Claude and ChatGPT depending on what you're discussing.
